name: angelina-tester
description: Human-like AI agent that discovers, understands, and tests any web app

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.build:web: npm install --prefix web && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n tsc,api,web -c gray,blue,green "tsc -w --preserveWatchOutput" "node --watch dist/server/index.js" "npm run dev --prefix web"
